name: Test Automation with Python
certifications: No single required certification; assessed by capstone projects
PCEP or PCAP from the Python Institute (optional)
ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE)

beginner.summary: For manual testers and QA engineers learning to automate tests in Python. Covers Python for testers from variables to classes, virtual environments, pytest tests, assertions, fixtures, parametrisation and markers, API testing with requests, JSON and schema checks, UI testing with Selenium and Playwright for Python, page objects, test data from files, logging and reports, Git and running tests in CI.
prerequisites: Has tested software by hand and understands test cases
Can install software on a laptop
outcomes: Write Python code for tests with functions, collections, files and classes
Build pytest suites with fixtures, parametrisation and markers
Automate API tests with requests and UI tests with Selenium or Playwright
Run the suite in CI with HTML or Allure reports

days.topic: Python for Testers Overview, Installation and Environment Setup
subtopics: Why Python is popular for test automation
What we will automate: APIs, web UIs and data
Installing Python and checking the version
VS Code or PyCharm with the Python extension
A first script and a first pytest test
days.lab_task: Install Python and an editor, create a virtual environment, install pytest, write a first script and a first passing test, and run both from the terminal.
days.deliverable: Working Python environment with a first test
checks: Python and pytest run from the virtual environment
The first script prints the expected output

days.topic: Python Syntax for Testers: Variables, Types and Strings
subtopics: print and input for quick checks
days.lab_task: Write small scripts that build test data strings, compare expected and actual values, and fix five scripts with syntax and type errors from their messages.
checks: Scripts build test data with variables and f-strings
Comparisons print the right pass or fail result

days.topic: Control Flow: Conditions and Loops for Test Logic
subtopics: while loops and when to avoid them
days.lab_task: Write a script that loops over a list of test inputs, decides pass or fail for each with conditions and prints a summary of results.
checks: Pass and fail decisions match the expected rules
The summary counts passes and failures

days.topic: Functions, Modules and Packages
days.lab_task: Move test data helpers into a module with documented functions, import them from a test file and use standard library modules for dates and random values.
checks: Helpers have parameters, defaults and docstrings
Tests import and use the helpers
Dates and random values come from standard modules

days.topic: Collections: Lists, Dictionaries, Sets and Tuples
days.lab_task: Represent users and orders as dictionaries and lists, filter and sort them with comprehensions and find duplicates with sets.
checks: Users and orders are stored as nested dictionaries and lists

days.topic: Files, JSON, CSV and Excel for Test Data
days.lab_task: Read test data from JSON, CSV and Excel files, convert it into a common structure and write a results file with pass and fail counts.
days.deliverable: Data loading module and results file
checks: Data loads from all three formats
All data ends up in the same structure
The results file has the right counts

days.topic: Exceptions, Logging and Debugging
subtopics: Using the debugger in the editor
days.lab_task: Add error handling and logging to the data loader, step through a failing function in the debugger and fix three bugs found with tracebacks.
days.deliverable: Robust data loader and debugging notes
checks: Missing or bad files give clear errors
Logs show progress and problems at the right levels
Three bugs are fixed with recorded causes

days.topic: Classes and Objects for Test Code
days.lab_task: Write a dataclass for test users, a base class for API clients and a subclass for one service, and use them in a script.
checks: The service client reuses the base client

days.topic: pytest Essentials: Tests, Assertions and Test Discovery
subtopics: Test outcomes: pass, fail, skip and xfail
days.lab_task: Write tests for a small pricing module covering normal values, boundaries and exceptions, run selected tests by name and keyword and configure pytest in pyproject.toml.
checks: Normal, boundary and error cases are tested
Tests run by name and keyword

days.topic: Fixtures, Parametrisation and Markers
days.lab_task: Create fixtures for test data and an API client, parametrise the pricing tests from a data list and mark smoke tests to run them alone.
checks: Tests receive data and clients from fixtures
Each data row runs as its own test

days.topic: API Testing with requests
days.lab_task: Write pytest tests for the course API's products endpoints with requests, covering GET, POST, PUT and DELETE, headers, status codes and response times.
checks: Status, headers and body fields are asserted

days.topic: JSON Validation, Schemas and API Test Data
days.lab_task: Validate product and order responses with jsonschema and Pydantic, create unique test data with Faker, write five negative tests and clean up created data.
days.deliverable: Schema checks, data helpers and negative tests
checks: Responses pass schema and model validation
Five negative cases return expected errors

days.topic: Web UI Testing with Selenium for Python
subtopics: Installing Selenium and drivers with Selenium Manager
days.lab_task: Automate login and search on the course web application with Selenium, use explicit waits and a browser fixture, and run the tests headless.
days.deliverable: Selenium test module with a browser fixture

days.topic: Web UI Testing with Playwright for Python
days.lab_task: Automate the same login and search with Playwright for Python, record traces on failure, run in Chromium and Firefox and compare effort and stability with Selenium.
checks: Effort and stability are compared with Selenium

days.topic: Page Objects for Python UI Tests
subtopics: Page classes with locators and actions
Passing the driver or page into objects
days.lab_task: Refactor the UI tests into page objects for login, search and product pages, and show that a changed locator needs one edit.
checks: Each page has a class with actions
A locator change is fixed in one place

days.topic: Data-Driven Tests from CSV, JSON and Excel
subtopics: Data for UI and API tests
When data-driven tests become too large
days.lab_task: Drive login and pricing tests from CSV, JSON and Excel files with readable test IDs and expected results in the data.
checks: Tests are generated from each file
Test IDs come from the data
Boundary and invalid rows are included

days.topic: Reports: pytest-html and Allure
days.lab_task: Produce pytest-html and Allure reports for the suite with steps, screenshots of UI failures and environment details, and share the Allure report.
checks: Tests are grouped by feature in Allure

days.topic: Git and Project Structure for Test Automation
subtopics: Folder structure for tests, pages and data
days.lab_task: Put the project in Git with a clean structure, a .gitignore, pinned dependencies and a README, and merge a change through a reviewed pull request.
days.deliverable: Repository with a merged pull request
checks: Tests, pages and data have clear folders
A change is merged through a reviewed pull request

days.topic: Running Python Tests in CI
subtopics: GitHub Actions or Jenkins for Python
Browsers in CI for UI tests
Running on pull requests and schedules
days.lab_task: Add a pipeline that installs dependencies, runs API and headless UI tests on pull requests and nightly, uses secrets for credentials and publishes the report.
checks: The pipeline runs on pull requests
The report is available from each run

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Python Test Suite for a Web Shop
days.lab_task: Build a Python test suite for a web shop with API tests, UI tests using page objects, fixtures, data-driven tests and Allure reporting, kept in Git and run in CI.
checks: API and UI tests cover the main journeys
Fixtures, page objects and data files are used
The suite runs in CI with reports

intermediate.summary: For testers and SDETs who write Python tests and now build a maintainable framework. Covers framework layers, configuration and environments, advanced fixtures and conftest design, pytest plugins and hooks, parallel runs with pytest-xdist, BDD with pytest-bdd and Behave, mocking with unittest.mock and responses, database testing, contract and property-based testing with Schemathesis and Hypothesis, async API testing with httpx, Docker and Testcontainers, mobile tests with the Appium Python client, test data factories, flaky tests, typing and linting, packaging, Robot Framework, Allure and CI pipelines.
prerequisites: Writes pytest tests with fixtures and parametrisation
Has automated API and UI tests in Python
Uses Git and has run tests in CI
outcomes: Design a layered Python test framework that a team can extend
Run large suites in parallel with reliable data and isolated dependencies
Add BDD, contract, property-based, mobile and database tests where they add value
Keep test code typed, linted, packaged and running in CI with clear reports

days.topic: Framework Layers for Python Test Automation
subtopics: Layers: tests, pages, API clients, data and utilities
days.lab_task: Restructure a flat Python suite into tests, pages, clients and data packages, write a contributor guide and have a colleague add a test using only the guide.
checks: Tests call pages and clients, not raw drivers or requests
A colleague adds a passing test from the guide
objectives: Make the framework easy to extend

days.topic: Configuration and Secrets for Python Test Suites
subtopics: Secrets from CI or a vault
days.lab_task: Add typed configuration for three environments, a --env command-line option and secrets from environment variables, and fail fast with a clear message on missing settings.
checks: No URLs or credentials are hard-coded
Missing settings stop the run clearly

days.topic: Advanced Fixtures and conftest Design
subtopics: Fixture scopes: function, class, module and session
days.lab_task: Redesign the suite's fixtures with session-scoped clients, factory fixtures for data, cleanup finalisers and layered conftest files, and show the fixture order with --setup-show.
checks: Expensive fixtures run once per session
Factory fixtures create data on demand
Created data is removed after tests

days.topic: pytest Plugins and Hooks
days.lab_task: Write hooks that attach screenshots on UI failures, skip tests marked for other environments and add a custom summary line, then move them into a local plugin.
checks: The hooks work as a plugin

days.topic: Parallel Runs with pytest-xdist
subtopics: Fixtures and session scope in parallel runs
days.lab_task: Run the suite with pytest-xdist, fix two tests that collide on shared data, isolate browser sessions and compare duration with serial runs.
checks: The suite passes with several workers
Duration drops compared with serial runs

days.topic: BDD in Python with pytest-bdd and Behave
days.lab_task: Write two features for checkout, implement them with pytest-bdd using existing fixtures and page objects, implement one in Behave and recommend a tool for the team.
days.deliverable: BDD features in two tools and a recommendation
checks: Scenarios pass in pytest-bdd and Behave

days.topic: Mocking and Stubbing: unittest.mock, pytest-mock and responses
subtopics: Mocking HTTP calls with responses or respx
days.lab_task: Test a client library with mocked HTTP responses for success, timeout and error, freeze time for an expiry check and verify the calls made.
checks: Success, timeout and error cases are mocked
The expiry check runs at a fixed time

days.topic: Database Testing with Python
subtopics: Verifying data after API or UI actions
days.lab_task: Create database fixtures that seed and roll back data, verify records created through the API, and test one stored procedure.
checks: Each test starts and ends with known data
The stored procedure returns correct results

days.topic: Contract and Property-Based Testing: Schemathesis and Hypothesis
subtopics: Testing APIs from their OpenAPI description
days.lab_task: Run Schemathesis against the course API's OpenAPI description, triage the failures it finds, and write Hypothesis tests for a pricing function that reveal an edge case.
days.deliverable: Generated test results, triage and property tests
checks: Found failures are classified as defects or spec gaps
A Hypothesis test finds and shrinks an edge case

days.topic: Async API Testing with httpx and pytest-asyncio
days.lab_task: Rewrite slow API checks with the httpx async client to run requests concurrently, test a streaming endpoint and a WebSocket message flow.
checks: WebSocket messages are sent and checked

days.topic: Docker and Testcontainers for Python Tests
days.lab_task: Start PostgreSQL and the service under test with testcontainers-python, run API tests against them and run the same setup in CI.
checks: API tests pass against the containers
The setup runs in the pipeline

days.topic: Mobile Automation with the Appium Python Client
subtopics: Running on emulators and device clouds
days.lab_task: Automate login and search in a mobile app with the Appium Python client, screen objects and a driver fixture, and run it on an emulator and a device cloud.
checks: Mobile tests pass on the emulator
Screen objects and fixtures are used
Tests run on a cloud device

days.topic: Test Data Factories with factory_boy and Faker
subtopics: Factories that create data through APIs
days.lab_task: Build factories for users, products and orders that create data through the API with Indian and UK locales, use them in ten tests and clean up afterwards.
checks: Factory data is removed after tests

days.topic: Flaky Tests: Detection, Reruns and Fixes
subtopics: Fixing timing, data and order problems
days.lab_task: Find flaky tests with repeated runs, diagnose three, fix them and add a limited rerun policy with reporting of reruns.
checks: Flaky tests are listed with failure rates
Three tests pass fifty runs after fixes

days.topic: Typing, Linting and Formatting Test Code
days.lab_task: Add type hints to the framework, configure Ruff and mypy, fix the reported issues, add pre-commit hooks and enforce the checks in CI.
days.deliverable: Typed, linted framework with checks in CI
checks: mypy or Pyright passes on the framework
Ruff passes with the agreed rules
CI fails on lint or type errors

days.topic: Packaging Shared Test Libraries
subtopics: When to share test code as a package
days.lab_task: Package the API clients and fixtures as an internal library, publish a version to a private index and install it in a second test project.
checks: The version appears in the private index
The second project uses the package

days.topic: Robot Framework with Python Libraries
subtopics: When Robot Framework fits a team
days.lab_task: Write Robot Framework tests for login and an API check, add a custom Python keyword library and compare readability and maintenance with pytest.
days.deliverable: Robot Framework tests, custom keyword and comparison
checks: Robot tests pass for UI and API
A custom Python keyword is used
The comparison with pytest is recorded

days.topic: Allure Reporting in Depth
subtopics: Attachments: screenshots, logs and API calls
Links to tickets and test cases
days.lab_task: Add nested steps, API call attachments, ticket links, categories and history to the Allure report and host it for the team.

days.topic: CI Pipelines for Python Test Frameworks
subtopics: Pipeline stages for lint, unit, API and UI tests
Matrix runs for Python versions and browsers
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline with lint and type checks, API and UI stages selected by markers, a browser matrix, cached dependencies, published Allure history and notifications.
checks: Lint, API and UI stages run in order
UI tests run on two browsers

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Team-Ready Python Test Framework
subtopics: API, UI, database and contract tests
days.lab_task: Build a team-ready Python framework for a web application with layered packages, typed configuration, factories, API, UI, database and contract tests, parallel runs with containers and a CI pipeline, then hand it to a colleague to extend.
checks: API, UI, database and contract tests run
Parallel CI runs pass with reports
A colleague adds a test without help

advanced.summary: For automation leads and SDETs who run Python test automation across teams. Covers test architecture for many services, a shared platform of plugins and packages, test impact analysis, performance testing with Locust, security test automation, data and ETL testing, testing machine learning and LLM systems, AI-assisted test generation, observability for test runs, contract testing at scale with Pact, chaos and resilience checks, test environments and data at scale, governance, migration from other frameworks, team enablement, strategy and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has built and maintained a Python test framework used by a team
Strong Python, pytest and CI skills
Understands services, data pipelines and cloud environments
outcomes: Architect Python test automation shared by many teams
Add performance, security, data and AI-system testing to quality
Keep large suites fast, observable and governed
Lead Python automation strategy and capability

days.topic: Test Architecture for Many Services and Teams
subtopics: Shared packages for clients, fixtures and reporting
days.lab_task: Design test architecture for five services with shared packages and generated clients, implement one generated client and upgrade two consumer projects to a new shared version.
days.deliverable: Architecture design, generated client and upgrade record
checks: Two projects use the shared packages
Both consumers pass after the upgrade
objectives: Architect test automation for many teams

days.topic: Building an Internal pytest Platform: Plugins, Templates and Standards
subtopics: Internal plugins for evidence, environments and reporting
Project templates with cookiecutter or copier
days.lab_task: Publish an internal pytest plugin and a project template, create a new test project from the template and document the platform for other teams.
days.deliverable: Plugin, template, new project and documentation
checks: The plugin installs from the private index
A new project runs tests on first generation
Platform docs cover setup, markers and support

days.topic: Test Impact Analysis and Smart Selection for Python Suites
subtopics: Mapping tests to code and services
days.lab_task: Add change-based test selection with coverage data, keep nightly full runs, and report feedback time, CI cost and any defects missed over two weeks.
checks: Pull requests run only affected tests plus smoke
Feedback time, cost and missed defects are reported

days.topic: Performance Testing with Locust
subtopics: Locust users, tasks and wait times
days.lab_task: Reuse the framework's API client in a Locust test with a custom load shape, run it distributed, add a CI check that fails on response time and analyse the results.
days.deliverable: Locust tests, CI check and analysis
checks: The Locust test uses the shared client
The load follows the custom shape
The CI check fails when thresholds are broken

days.topic: Security Test Automation in Python
subtopics: Security checks that automation can cover
OWASP ZAP automation through its Python API
days.lab_task: Drive a ZAP scan from Python against the course app, add authorisation matrix and header tests, fuzz two inputs and triage the findings with developers.
days.deliverable: Security tests, scan results and triaged findings
checks: The ZAP scan runs from Python
Authorisation matrix tests run for all roles

days.topic: Data and ETL Testing with pandas and Great Expectations
days.lab_task: Write data tests for an ETL job that check counts, nulls, duplicates and transformation rules between source and target, and run them after each pipeline run.
days.deliverable: Data test suite and quality report
checks: Source and target data are reconciled
A data quality report is produced after each run

days.topic: Testing Machine Learning Systems
subtopics: What can go wrong in ML systems
Data validation for training and inference
Model performance tests on held-out data
days.lab_task: Write tests for a model service covering input validation, accuracy on a held-out set, invariance to irrelevant changes and a fairness metric, and run them on each model version.
checks: Bad inputs are rejected by the service
Accuracy thresholds are tested per version
The fairness metric is reported and gated

days.topic: Testing LLM Applications and Agents
subtopics: Why LLM outputs need different tests
tools: LLM evaluation library such as DeepEval or Ragas
days.lab_task: Build an evaluation suite for an LLM-backed support assistant with structure, factuality and safety checks, prompt injection tests and cost tracking, and run it on two prompt versions.
days.deliverable: LLM evaluation suite and version comparison
checks: Both prompt versions are scored on the dataset
Injection and unsafe requests are handled
Cost and latency per run are recorded

days.topic: AI-Assisted Test Generation in Python
subtopics: Generating tests from code and specifications
Mutation testing to check test strength
days.lab_task: Generate tests for a module with an AI assistant, review them, measure their strength with mutation testing, improve weak ones and record effort and results.
days.deliverable: Reviewed tests, mutation results and effort record
checks: Mutation scores are recorded before and after review
objectives: Check test strength with mutation testing

days.topic: Observability for Python Test Runs
subtopics: Correlation IDs from tests to services
Dashboards for pass rate, duration and flakiness
Using test data in incident reviews
days.lab_task: Send correlation IDs from tests, export results to a database with a plugin, build a dashboard and set an alert for rising flakiness.
checks: Failed tests link to service traces

days.topic: Contract Testing at Scale with Pact for Python
days.lab_task: Write consumer contracts for two clients, verify them on the provider with provider states, gate deployment with can-i-deploy and run a breaking-change workflow.
checks: Consumer pacts are in the broker

days.topic: Chaos and Resilience Checks from Python Tests
days.lab_task: Inject latency and dropped connections into a dependency with Toxiproxy from pytest, check the service's timeouts and fallbacks, and report the weaknesses found.
checks: Timeouts and fallbacks are verified or fail clearly

days.topic: Ephemeral Environments and Synthetic Data for Python Suites
days.lab_task: Run the suite against preview environments with readiness checks and seeded synthetic data, and measure environment-related failures before and after.
checks: Each pull request gets an environment
Data is synthetic and seeded per run

days.topic: Governance for Python Test Automation
subtopics: Standards for structure, naming and data
days.lab_task: Write standards and a dependency policy, build a coverage map for five services, review twenty tests, remove obsolete ones and report status to leads.
days.deliverable: Standards, coverage map, review records and report
checks: Standards cover structure, data and ownership
The map shows coverage per service

days.topic: Migrating from Java or Robot Framework Suites to pytest
subtopics: Reasons to migrate and reasons not to
Mapping TestNG and JUnit concepts to pytest
Running old and new suites side by side
days.lab_task: Migrate twenty tests from a Java or Robot Framework suite to pytest, run both for a week and write a plan for the remaining tests with training needs.
checks: The plan covers the remaining tests and training

days.topic: Testing Event-Driven Systems with Python
subtopics: Kafka and RabbitMQ clients in Python
days.lab_task: Start Kafka in a container, call an API that publishes events, consume and validate them, test duplicate handling and check that bad messages reach the dead-letter topic.
checks: Bad messages reach the dead-letter topic

days.topic: Enabling Teams in Python Test Automation
subtopics: Pairing and code review as teaching
days.lab_task: Assess a QA team's Python skills, design a learning path, provide a starter project and coach a manual tester to a first merged automated test.
days.deliverable: Skills assessment, learning path and first merged test
checks: Each person has a skills rating
The starter project runs on a new machine
A manual tester merges a first test

days.topic: Strategy for Python Test Automation in an Organisation
days.lab_task: Write an automation strategy for an organisation using Python for API, data and UI testing, with risks, layers, ownership and a one-year roadmap, and present it to leaders.
days.deliverable: Strategy and roadmap with presentation notes

days.topic: Troubleshooting Large Python Test Suites
subtopics: Reading logs, traces and reports together
days.lab_task: Diagnose four failures in a large suite (a dependency conflict, an xdist ordering issue, an environment problem and a data collision), reproduce two locally and write a troubleshooting guide.
checks: Each failure has a confirmed cause
The guide covers the steps used

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Python Quality Platform for a Product Organisation
days.lab_task: Design and build a Python quality platform for three teams with shared packages, change-based selection, performance, security, data and AI-system tests, dashboards and governance, and present it to engineering leadership.
checks: All teams use the shared packages
Performance, security, data and AI tests exist for critical services
